ownerDecision.request: make 4 new chinnese tannks combining variations of vt4a1, qilin, kunlun, annd ztz 99a2 with modernized versions of the lonngwei turret which i like the shape of
ownerDecision.scope: Four original concepts (the Four Symbols), each its host's hull, hull armour, running gear and mobility under the ZTZ-99 Longwei's release-262 arrowhead turret with a modernized kit of its own (docs/references/tanks/longwei_family.md). The hosts are unchanged by them. Owner, the same day: "make the squares on frront cheeks adjusted properly so its not weird and properly varies. also add a big floodlight on thhe baihu" (the face-fitted cassettes, each concept its own face pattern, and the Baihu's searchlight).

ztz99a2_qinglong.silhouette: Original Chinese game concept (release 264): the ZTZ-99A2 hull under a heavy modernized Longwei turret: a 3 x 2 grid of FY-5 cassettes on each arrowhead face, two rows on each side module, a remote 12.7 mm station, the GL-5-style suite with a rear launcher pair and closed armoured stowage round the bustle.

vt4a1_baihu.silhouette: Original Chinese game concept (release 264): the VT-4A1 hull under an export Longwei turret: V-ridged chevron cassettes on the arrowhead faces and cassettes on the side modules, a big searchlight right of the gun, laser-warning receivers in place of the hard-kill suite, the QJC-88 on its pintle and a slat screen round the bustle.

t72b3_zhuque.silhouette: Original Chinese game concept (release 264): the Qilin's T-72B3 hull and Chinese package under the Longwei turret: its two large dual-reactive modules a face, cassettes on the side modules, the GL-5-style suite, the QJC-88 on its pintle and closed armoured stowage round the bustle.

t72b3m_xuanwu.silhouette: Original Chinese game concept (release 264): the Kunlun's T-72B3M hull and Chinese package under an assault Longwei turret: four columns of three small reactive tiles on each arrowhead face and cassettes on the side modules, infrared dazzlers and laser warners, and the QJC-88 on its pintle.
